resources.string: Looking for your PC on Wi-Fi…
Keep WinDock running on your PC and connect both devices to the same LAN or VPN.\nTry again, or enter the PC\'s LAN or Tailscale IPv4 address.
Could not reach your PC. Check the connection and try again.
Connect to your PC, or search for another one.
Enter your PC\'s LAN or Tailscale IPv4 address, optionally followed by :port.
Wi-Fi selected · Phone and PC on the same network
USB selected · USB tethering must be on
USB disconnected. Looking for your PC on Wi-Fi…

1. Connect your phone to the PC with a data-capable USB cable.

2. In Android Settings, turn on USB tethering (usually under Hotspot & tethering). USB debugging is not needed.

3. Keep WinDock running on Windows, then return here and tap Find USB PC.

If Windows asks, allow WinDock on your trusted USB network. Tethering may also share your mobile data with Windows; disable mobile data if you do not want that.

This USB attempt stays on the cable. Choose Connect by Wi-Fi for wireless. Reopening the app without a USB link returns to Wi-Fi.
Looking for your PC over USB…
No USB PC found. Check the cable, USB tethering, and WinDock on Windows. For wireless, tap Connect by Wi-Fi above. You can also enter the PC’s USB IPv4 address below.
Looking for PCs running WinDock on your network…
Choose a PC. New connections may ask for its pairing code.
No PCs found. Keep WinDock running on the same network, refresh, or enter its address. For USB setup, use Connect by USB on the connection screen.
Not found this scan · Tap to retry

Remove this saved PC and stop automatic reconnection. A running PC can still appear under Available now; selecting it saves it again. This does not disconnect the current session or revoke pairing. Older hosts are remembered by address only.
Display settings for this phone only. Your PC display is unchanged.

At a timed limit, the dock goes black and allows Android to turn the screen off. Your phone’s screen timeout may add a delay. Tap to return while the screen is still on; after it sleeps, use your normal wake control.
Lower brightness and screen breaks reduce display wear. These options cannot guarantee that burn-in will never happen. Stay awake keeps the display on only while this dock is visible.
Open Android Settings to change this option.
Screen resting. Tap to return to the dock.

Download the APK and open it to install. A matching signing key keeps your phone settings. Updates are installed manually.
Open windock.vercel.app in a browser to download the update.
